description.content:
Provides a list of upcoming non-trading dates, such as weekends or public holidays, for a specified currency pair. Common use cases include situations where this information needs to be provided, or for planning upcoming conversion bookings.

Many currencies are triangulated; this means that holidays affecting the intermediary currency, as well as the sale and purchase currencies, will impact transactions. Find out more at our support article.
(Required) Concatenated string of the currency codes for the two currencies involved, e.g. "USDEUR".
Start date of conversion. ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD.
A contact UUID for the sub-account you're acting on behalf of.

Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

description.content: Gets a list of payment purpose codes for a given currency and entity type. When initiating cross-border payments, the central bank of the country may require a purpose to be included with your transaction in order for your payment to be accepted and processed. If a payment purpose code is required but not provided, your payment may be delayed or rejected by the beneficiary bank.
(Required) Three-letter ISO currency code for the currency in which payment will be made. No purpose codes will be returned if an invalid currency code is given.
Legal entity type - company or individual. (This can only be one of company,individual)
(Required) Two-letter ISO country code of the bank account.
